references.text: God's promise that Caleb would receive the land he had spied out because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly
Moses confirms the promise that Caleb will receive the land where he set his foot, because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly
Caleb receives Hebron as an inheritance and drives out the three sons of Anak from there
Hebron is given to Caleb's clan, the city formerly called Kiriath-Arba
Caleb receives Hebron as an inheritance, just as Moses had promised
Caleb, son of Jephunneh, is sent as a spy from the tribe of Judah
The spies come to Hebron where the descendants of Anak lived
Hebron is mentioned as an important place in the land of Canaan, where Abraham bought a burial site
